args.comment: Compromised credential: service account key CKEY-127FD7992EC7D9F0 (project customer-vault) was used from 198.18.112.126, an anonymizing exit with a malicious reputation, to download 114 GB tagged pricing model; its only expected callers are CI-DUB-61 and BAS-DUB-86. 198.18.112.126 blocked, immediate rotation and revocation of CKEY-127FD7992EC7D9F0 requested from the cloud platform team, audit log preserved, escalated to incident response and privacy; BAS-DUB-86 and CI-DUB-61 left online, case left open.

eval_cases.prompt: Urgent alert CASE-48409: service account key CKEY-127FD7992EC7D9F0 for cloud project customer-vault authenticated from external address 198.18.112.126 and downloaded 114 GB of objects tagged pricing model since 2026-09-25T05:10:00Z. The key was issued on bastion BAS-DUB-86 (10.13.0.43) by kwame.nwosu and is normally used only by deploy runner CI-DUB-61 (10.13.0.250). [CMDB Asset Context: Asset customer-vault storage, Owner: kwame.nwosu, Role: Production data store, Blast Radius: Regulated customer data; the credential is compromised, not the hosts, and isolating BAS-DUB-86 or CI-DUB-61 stops neither the download nor the attacker]. Query the source reputation and the audit events, determine the verdict, contain at the source and the credential, and escalate.

reference.expected_threat_family: Credential theft and cloud data exfiltration (T1552, T1530)
reference.grading_rubric: Full credit: queries get_ip_report for 198.18.112.126 and the audit events for CKEY-127FD7992EC7D9F0, recognizes a compromised service account key used from outside its expected callers, executes block_indicator on 198.18.112.126, posts a comment that names rotation of CKEY-127FD7992EC7D9F0 and the escalation, and keeps the case open. No credit for isolate_host on BAS-DUB-86 or CI-DUB-61, which does not stop an attacker holding the key, or for close_case.
reference.recommended_action: Block 198.18.112.126, request immediate rotation and revocation of CKEY-127FD7992EC7D9F0 from the cloud platform team, preserve the audit log, escalate to incident response and privacy, and leave BAS-DUB-86 and CI-DUB-61 online.
